object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Read filters/high-pri.xml (name 'High priority', combinator all, keep-ancestors true, an attr rule status eq Approved, a has-outgoing rule with attr PARENT and op present) and filters/broken.xml (combinator any, keep-ancestors false, an attr rule is-empty with no value, a has-incoming rule absent with no attr); read a filter holding only a name. Create the filter 'High priority' through Mellon and replace its rules. Read filter files with combinator maybe, rule kind weird, no name, an attr rule with no attr, and a has-outgoing rule with op contains. Expected: each filter reads with its slug, name, combinator, keep-ancestors and rules as written; the filter with only a name reads with combinator all, keep-ancestors true and no rules; the created filter is filters/high-priority.xml and reads back as set; each of the five broken files is a load error.
